fields.label: Event write-up
fields.sample:
For years we’ve laughed at the same table and cried to the same songs. Now one of us is setting off on her most beautiful journey. The dress is chosen, the invitations are out; just one thing left: one last night with the girls!
Tonight is her night. Laughter allowed, dancing mandatory, sleep forbidden.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample: A huge thank-you to every one of you for making this night unforgettable! Without you, we couldn’t have laughed or danced this much. See you at the wedding; we’ve saved your spot on the dance floor.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: The bride is running away… but just for one night!

elements.name: Kapak altyazısı
elements.text: Caught on camera: the bride-to-be raising a glass before cutting the cake on her final rehearsal night.

elements.name: Haber başlığı
elements.text: Girls on alert: long night, no sleep allowed

elements.name: Öncü haber
elements.text:
EX­CLU­SIVE — The sweet­est member of a girl gang that has been laugh­ing around the same table for years is get­ting ready for her last single night before the wed­ding. Ac­cord­ing to in­for­ma­tion ob­tained by this paper, the night will kick off with a crown­ing cer­e­mo­ny and last until the first light of morn­ing; it has been con­firmed that the girls are bring­ing spare shoes.
The groom’s camp has issued no state­ment on the matter; how­ev­er, we have learned that the groom will keep his phone on silent all night. All the rules of the night, the pro­gram and the girls’ ex­clu­sive mis­sion card are on our inside pages.

elements.name: Dosya metni
elements.text: We reveal what nobody knows. Some are truly shocking.

elements.name: Dosya metni
elements.text: Pink is a must, phones stay in pockets, and the word “ex” is banned.

elements.name: Dosya metni
elements.text: Eight missions to complete before the night is over. The one with the most points is queen.

elements.name: Söz
elements.text: “Tonight is her night. We’re just here to carry her shoes.”

elements.name: Söz
elements.text: “Tiara: ready. Confetti: ready. Missing: the bride’s nerve.”

elements.name: Söz
elements.text: “We’ll dance till morning, then sleep for a week.”

elements.name: Son dakika metni
elements.text: Cake shape confirmed · DJ adds the same song to the list three times · Please don’t call the groom tonight

elements.name: Kısa haber
elements.text: The bride’s tiara is under tight guard in the maid of honor’s bag. Crown­ing at 20:00.

elements.name: Kısa haber
elements.text: The groom’s friends fear the girls’ night will be more fun than theirs.

elements.name: Kısa haber
elements.text: Any guest caught yawn­ing will get an in­stant dance penal­ty. No ap­peals.

elements.name: Gerçek 1
elements.text: She takes her coffee with milk but never admits it; at cafés she orders it black in front of everyone.

elements.name: Gerçek 2
elements.text: She picks the same song every time at karaoke. We all know it by heart; she still mixes up the words.

elements.name: Gerçek 3
elements.text: Half the photos on her phone are cats, the other half desserts she’s eaten. The groom comes third.

elements.name: Gerçek 4
elements.text: First on the dance floor, last to leave it. Her shoes, though, usually get left somewhere.

elements.name: Gerçek 5
elements.text: She cried three times at her dress fitting: twice from joy, once at the price tag.

elements.name: Gerçek 6
elements.text: The first time she saw the groom, she whispered to us, “Who’s that?” Now we know the answer.

elements.name: Gerçek 7
elements.text: She looks like a planner, but her best memories always come from last-minute decisions.

elements.name: Gerçek 8
elements.text: She never eats dessert alone; anyone who reaches over with a fork gets a bite.

elements.name: Gerçek 9
elements.text: Our best listener and our worst secret keeper. We suspect she commissioned this paper herself.

elements.name: Gerçek 10
elements.text: She has just one wish for tonight: to have all of us by her side. We promised, and here we are.

elements.name: Köşe alt
elements.text: We heard it, we print it

elements.name: Dedikodular
elements.text:
★ According to backstage leaks, the maid of honor tried the bride’s tiara on at three different shops before settling on the pinkest one.
★ The night’s DJ put the song the bride said “you really don’t have to play” at the very top of the list.
★ The groom’s mother is said to be following the girls’ night “with great interest.” Hello to her from here!
★ We’ve learned the quietest member of the group secretly took dance lessons for tonight. Brace yourselves for a surprise.
★ The bride-to-be was overheard saying, “I’m going to bed early tonight.” Nobody believed it, herself included.
★ The group has been voting for three days on what to write on the cake. Front-runner: “Final night!”
★ The groom’s plan to drop by the girls’ night “by chance” has fallen through. We have a guest list at the door.

elements.name: Bant başlığı
elements.text: Caught by the paparazzi: the girls in action

elements.name: Kare altyazısı
elements.text: Well past midnight, the group that wouldn’t leave the dance floor asked the DJ for one more song.

elements.name: Kare altyazısı
elements.text: Raising a toast to the bride-to-be, the girls didn’t forget to pose for our camera.

elements.name: Kare altyazısı
elements.text: The only shot leaked from the mission card planning meeting. The plan’s details remain secret.

elements.name: Söyleşi
elements.text:
— What will you miss most about single life?
Having the duvet all to myself. And the remote.
— Does the groom know about tonight?
He knows. Just not the details, and let’s keep it that way.
— Any request for the girls?
Show me the photos in the morning before you post them.
— What’s the song of the night?
You all know it. That song again, at full volume.
— What do you love most about your dress?
The pockets. Yes, it has pockets; I’ll carry tissues and candy in them.
— A promise to the girls?
A girls’ night every month, even after the wedding. Promise, signed and sealed.
— One word for the wedding day?
Excitement. And comfortable shoes.

elements.name: Kural 1
elements.text: The bride tries everything first; no saying no.

elements.name: Kural 2

elements.name: Kural 4
elements.text: The word “ex” is banned. Say it and you sing.

elements.name: Kural 5
elements.text: Everyone dances with the bride before the night ends.

elements.name: Kural 6
elements.text: No calling the groom, no texting, no tipping him off.

elements.name: Kural 7

elements.text: Pink clouds, a light cocktail breeze

elements.name: Hava metni
elements.text: Storm of laughter at the table, low visibility

elements.name: Fotoğraf altyazısı
elements.text: Pink cocktails are ready: the first glass to the bride, the second to the groom’s patience.

elements.name: Kokteyl metni
elements.text: Pink grapefruit, fresh mint and plenty of sparkle. The first drink of the night; no refusals.

elements.name: Kokteyl metni
elements.text: Strawberry, lemon and a drop of romance. Not recommended during the vows.

elements.name: Kokteyl metni
elements.text: Ginger, honey and energy all night long. Second one free for shoe carriers.

elements.name: Kokteyl metni
elements.text: Blackberry, foam and a secret. Only the bartender and the bride know the recipe.

elements.name: Kokteyl metni
elements.text: Lemonade on lots of ice, alcohol-free (for now). Served with simit.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Koç
elements.text: Leaving the dance floor just isn’t you.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Boğa
elements.text: The biggest slice of cake is yours.

elements.name: Burç yorumu İkizler
elements.text: You’ll be torn between two cocktails.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Yengeç
elements.text: Old photos will bring tears to your eyes.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Aslan
elements.text: No tiara, but all the spotlight.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Başak
elements.text: Everyone’s bags are in your care.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Terazi
elements.text: The best shot of the night is yours.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Yay
elements.text: You’ll be first to discover the surprise.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Oğlak
elements.text: You’ll be the one sending everyone home.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Kova
elements.text: Befriending the DJ is only a matter of time.

elements.name: Burç yorumu Balık
elements.text: On slow songs, you’re on tissue duty.

elements.name: Alt bilgi
elements.text: Go Post · Night guide · Break the rules, sing a song; object, sing two

elements.name: Üst başlık
elements.text: Finish before night’s end; get the bride’s signature

elements.name: Görev 2
elements.text: Get marriage advice from a stranger

elements.name: Görev 3
elements.text: Sing a short song for the bride

elements.name: Görev 5
elements.text: Call the groom and pay him a compliment

elements.name: Görev 7
elements.text: Wear the bride’s tiara for one minute

elements.name: Görev 8
elements.text: Dance the longest dance of the night

elements.name: Kart notu
elements.text: The top scorer is crowned queen of the night; the prize is wearing the bride’s tiara for one whole song.

elements.name: Arka altyazı
elements.text: Full squad present: sunglasses stayed on till morning.

elements.name: Reçete
elements.text:
1. Plenty of water and a warm simit.
2. Sunglasses; allowed indoors, too.
3. Phone on silent until noon.
4. One message to the girls’ group: “So glad I have you.”
5. Photos get posted only after the bride’s approval.
6. Shoes get a week of rest.

elements.name: İlan 1
elements.text: The bride’s tiara, lost at midnight. Last seen on the dance floor near the DJ booth. Return to the maid of honor; reward: one dance.

elements.name: İlan 2
elements.text: The left shoe of a pair of heels. The right one is still in the bride’s hand, waiting hopefully. Finder is kindly asked to carry it to the taxi.

elements.name: İlan 3
elements.text: Years with the girls, talks that lasted till morning and every photo from tonight. No offers accepted.

elements.name: İlan 4
elements.text: The bride’s single-girl apartment. Comfy couch, nothing but ice cream in the fridge. Perfect for girls’ nights; the neighbors are used to it.

elements.name: İlan 5
elements.text: Experienced tissue carrier wanted for the wedding day. Experience with tears required; a sturdy shoulder is a plus.

elements.name: İlan 6
elements.text: No one will be called and no messages answered until noon tomorrow. For emergencies: the simit seller.

elements.name: İlan 7
elements.text: Thanks to the bartender who saw us to the door at the end of the night, and to the venue’s neighbors for their patience.

elements.name: İlan 8
elements.text: From the groom’s side: “Girls, we’re grateful you returned our bride safe and sound.” We couldn’t agree more.

elements.name: Alt bilgi
elements.text: Go Post · Personalized edition · Not for sale; passed from hand to hand among the girls
